title: DS Generalized Kingdom Analysis: Tomb, Watchtower, Masterpiece, Pooka

sources.author: terracubist
sources.note: Worked example (Kingdom 1) of a procedural pre-game analysis; kingdom in an image (raw/blog/img/gka1.png). Homework kingdoms 2-7 have no analysis and are not used.

quality_note: A single pre-game analysis by a self-described newer player, written as a teaching example; no playtest or game result.

kingdom.setup_notes: Pooka's Heirloom: each player starts with Cursed Gold in place of one Copper.

edition: Dominion Online. Masterpiece is first-edition Guilds. Colonies/Shelters not shown.
